summary:
Qualify the actual active producer and complete consumer order early. A legacy stored namespace-handle schema could not truthfully describe the delegated bridge's owned-pause output. Home added a distinct capture schema; Root joined its actual helper/pause birth, namespaces, boot, source, handles and original clock rather than fabricating legacy fields. Actual producer-to-consumer controls also showed the prior consumer refusing that same output. A worker gate cannot await evidence produced only after releasing that gate: the source design separates private bootstrap, capture, Root live arm and old-store exposure. Home retains complete custody, gates, FD/writer and backing integration. Source return: https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6411272729 .

Allow an owned process to finish before observing its retirement. A proposed executor demanded live controller/supervisor identities after a fast fixture had already retired. The repair first actually waits the owned scope client, joins immutable supervisor/controller wait receipts, then independently verifies cold/cgroup absence as typed ALREADY_RETIRED. No failed live-manager RPC becomes success. A later causal control exposed another boundary: a status writer can flush provisional success and then exit3. Its death and file cannot replace the Root shell's actual second-process wait0, bound by exact fresh spec/nonce marker. The repaired executor passed34pure controls and independent review; actual Home admission remained unselected. https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6412147413 .

Use actual facility limits and phase overlap. Development-container CPU/memory ceilings are not Home facts. Observe real parent and ancestor finite/max limits, current capacity, selected helper share and separate native hard limits. A process timer is not hard forest containment. Complete source/runtime/ELF closure, operator and output-writer custody remain actual admission inputs, not facts created by a dictionary. New ordinary controller/collector processes require their own declared reservation rather than silently reusing the original Root helper allowance.

Delivered messages do not prove an owner is running. Root queued findings to a completed worker and caused avoidable idle time; explicit follow-up activation and running-state verification repaired that process error. Root withdrew the stale estimate and owned it at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6411375615 . Reuse unchanged qualified bytes and fetch only missing determining evidence. Home's existing OAuth supplied private run/job/Checks unavailable to Root's credential; no new token/App or unchanged CI rerun was needed. Policy403 remains unavailable, never empty policy. Coordination costs and token savings are unmeasured.

Consume each authenticated action durably before effects. Review found that a failed observe without an arm could be followed by a successful attempt using a valid arm. The repair records an exclusive action entry before validation/staging/dispatch and refuses prior entries or failures. New directories fsync themselves and then their parent after metadata setup. Fourteen causal controls and exact source review approved that repair, retaining original failures. https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6412999484 . Copying ordinary JSON into a Root-owned file does not create a reviewed Root admission, actual producer provenance or accepted native qualification. The trusted frontend must supply those separately.

Custody must survive uncertain publication and controller failure. An ordinary controller could release its advisory lock after an uncertain Root send before its collector existed. The repair transfers the same lock open-file-description to a distinct selected persistent owner before sending. Retained ownership is committed before any possibly visible arm acknowledgment; publication cancellation retains Unknown. Settlement joins the exact held spec/nonce, original, parent, selection, sources and actual proof bytes. Actual descriptor release and terminal state precede a settled acknowledgment. Lost acknowledgment after real release remains the original failure with current release metadata; it cannot trigger a stale-descriptor close or Root retry. Lease expiry is not retirement.

Root approved that exact ordinary source after30pure controls and independent review, preserving earlier19/27-control packets, failed attempts and incomplete discovery. https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6414319746 . Actual persistent Home owner/channel/registry, accountable lifetime/recovery and complete runtime/capacity inputs remained unassembled. The separate host-versus-engine identity issue is captured in platform/user-namespace-host-identity. Source, CI, knowledge and current board reads establish none of the native qualification, export, bake, registration, installed-fleet or consumer effects. Original failures, separate clocks and scoped Unknowns remain; Atlas grants no operation.
title: Verify producer context, original outcomes and custody
